lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are organized into roughly linear vertical columns; the density is highest in the mid-flank region with approximately 6-8 distinct columns visible in the field of view.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical striae of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal spot alignments, forming an irregular grid pattern where spots act as nodal points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal carinae exhibit a sharp intensity gradient transition, running parallel to the longitudinal axis of the body across the upper third of the visible flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette displays a scattered distribution of high-intensity spots, concentrated primarily along the lower and posterior boundaries of the fin surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible presence of several remora individuals (Echeneidae) swimming adjacent to the ventral side of the main body and posterior to the pectoral fin.
